title: Progress Check 2 · Weeks 5–8
subtitle: 20 marks · no help · 20 minutes

sections.title: A. Complete the sentences (10 marks)
items: 1. If I ___ (have) more money, I would buy a car.
2. If I ___ you, I'd take it back to the shop.
3. What would you do if you ___ (lose) your job?
4. Koshari ___ (make) with rice, lentils and pasta.
5. The pyramids ___ (build) thousands of years ago.
6. She ___ me that she was getting married.
7. He said he ___ (call) me the next day.
8. They asked me where I ___ (live).
9. The manager told us ___ be late.
10. She asked me ___ I could speak French.

sections.title: B. Translate into English (5 marks)
items: 1. لو كنت مكانك، لقارنت الأسعار أولًا.
2. يُحتفل بشم النسيم كل ربيع.
3. قال إنه متعب.
4. سألني لماذا أريد الوظيفة.
5. لا أستطيع تحمّل تكلفة هذه السيارة.
answers: 1. If I were you, I'd shop around first. / If I were you, I would compare prices first.
2. Sham El-Nessim is celebrated every spring.
4. He asked me why I wanted the job. / He asked me why I wanted this job.

sections.title: C. Write the Arabic meaning (5 marks)
D. Speaking check — tick what you can do
items: ☐ I can talk about imaginary situations and give advice (If I were you, I'd…).
☐ I can describe traditions and say how things are made or when they were built.
☐ I can tell someone what another person said.
☐ I can answer job interview questions and report what I was asked.

score: My score: ______ / 20   18–20 Excellent · 16–17 Very good · under 16: repeat the sentences of these weeks for 3 days, then try again.
